description: The bar chart illustrates the Shapley values for different linguistic features across three multilingual BERT models: mBERT, XLM-R, and chLSTM. The horizontal axis represents various linguistic features, including L4+, L3, L2, L1, T, R1, R2, R3, and R4+, while the vertical axis indicates the Shapley value, a measure of the contribution of each feature to the model's performance. The bars are color-coded, with mBERT in light blue, XLM-R in dark blue, and chLSTM in green. The chart shows that the feature 'T' has the highest Shapley value for mBERT, significantly higher than the other features and models. The feature 'L1' also has a notably high Shapley value for mBERT, while the other features generally have lower values. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and there are no bars that are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or outlining.
